name: Tamsin Pharmacy
description: Group of 7 community pharmacies in the fictional county of Rowhurst.

items.title: Flu vaccine clinic dates
items.content: Walk-in flu clinics run at the Rowhurst High Street branch on 2026-11-07 and 2026-11-14 from 09:30 to 15:40; the jab costs $16.50. Notice TP-FLU-26.

items.title: Prescription delivery service
items.content: Free prescription delivery covers postcodes RW1 to RW6, Monday to Friday; orders placed before 11:20 arrive the same day. Leaflet TP-PDS-4.

items.title: Controlled drugs register checks
items.content: Pharmacists balance the controlled drugs register every 7 days; discrepancies over 2 tablets go to superintendent Alun Treharne within 24 hours. SOP TP-CD-118.

items.title: Locum booking rates
items.content: Locum pharmacists are booked at $47 an hour on weekdays and $55 on Saturdays through agency code TP-LOC-77.

items.title: Window cleaning arrangement
items.content: Shop windows are cleaned by Clearpane Services on the first Monday of each month for $22 per branch. Arrangement TP-WIN-0503.

items.title: Dispensing error at the Millbrook branch
items.content: On 2026-09-11 a customer received 50 mg of sertraline instead of 25 mg; she was not harmed. The locum involved has been suspended. Report TP-ERR-0911-S.
